title: Healthier Energy Drink Series - Celsius Energy Drink Product Review
description:
Healthier energy drinks.... what does that mean exactly? Well, as long as an energy drink doesnt have sugar in it, it is fairly healthy. The remaining ingredients are good for you. But some companies go above and beyond to give you healthier ingredients and Celsius energy is one of those companies. More below



If you'd like to show support for the channel and get some perks, check out my channel membership: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5Ljde6CdKzkb0Yjy7rT6PA/join

Celsius energy has really gone the healthy route with their drinks to make them different from the rest. They tried to go so healthy that they don't even want to be known as an energy drink. They want to be called a fitness drink. This drink also tends to taste fairly natural too. When they give you a blueberry flavor, its not a sweet blueberry flavor, its a natural blue berry flavor and this rends to ake the drink a bit more underwhelming in flavor, unless you like the natural flavors. 

That being said, Celsius has continued to grow over the years and can be found in just about every store from convenience stores to grocery stores to gas stations. It really has shown people that not ALL energy drinks are bad for you and some of them are even more healthy for you than others. What makes Celsius Energy so healthy? All the details in the review!
